definitions.explanation: The month after this one; the coming month. Used to refer to future events or plans in the month that follows the current one.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}⟦{何|なに}→なに：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What will you do next month?

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→しごと：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めます→はじめる：00531_hajimeru⟧。
{来月|らいげつ}⟦{日本|にほん}→にほん：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→いく：00119_iku⟧。⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→うれしい：00822_ureshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to Japan next month. I'm very happy about it.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{始|はじ}め→はじめ：02931_hajime⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→ともだち：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→にほん：03876_nihon⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|く}る→くる：00254_kuru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→たのしみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My friend is coming from Japan at the beginning of next month, so I'm really looking forward to it.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→あたらしい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→かいしゃ：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}きます→はたらく：00503_hataraku⟧。⟦{今|いま}→いま：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→じゅんび：01431_junbi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→いそがしい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{楽|たの}しみ→たのしみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧にしています。
examples.english: I'll start working at a new company next month. I'm busy preparing now, but I'm looking forward to it.

notes:
{来月|らいげつ} refers to the month following the current one and can function as both a noun and a time adverb.

TIME REFERENCE SERIES:
- ⟦{先月|せんげつ}→せんげつ：00751_sengetsu⟧: last month
- ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→こんげつ：00720_kongetsu⟧: this month
- {来月|らいげつ}: next month

The prefix らい- ("coming, next") also appears in ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→らいしゅう：00746_raishuu⟧ (next week) and ⟦{来年|らいねん}→らいねん：00745_rainen⟧ (next year).

USAGE:
Like other time nouns, {来月|らいげつ} often appears without a particle: {来月|らいげつ}⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}します→ひっこす：01171_hikkosu⟧ (I'm moving next month). Use ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to connect it to a following noun: {来月|らいげつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→よてい：00824_yotei⟧ (next month's plans).
